# Publishing Runbook

## Dry run

```bash
uv run regional-metrics build performance-metrics --dry-run
```

## Build locally

```bash
uv run regional-metrics build performance-metrics --output data/derived/performance_metrics.gpkg
```

## Publish

```bash
ARCGIS_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true uv run regional-metrics publish performance-metrics --input data/derived/performance_metrics.gpkg --yes
```

## Publish dry run

```bash
uv run regional-metrics publish performance-metrics --input data/derived/performance_metrics.gpkg --dry-run
```

This validates the local file and prints:

- target hosted layer title
- create vs overwrite mode
- join field and geometry column
- row and column counts
- tags

No ArcGIS Online changes are made during `--dry-run`.

Publishing is blocked unless both conditions are true:

- `ARCGIS_PUBLISH_ENABLED=true` is set in the environment
- `--yes` is passed on the command line

This is intentional to prevent accidental hosted-layer overwrites.

## Rollback guidance

- Export the last known-good hosted layer before publishing.
- Keep comparison outputs under `data/derived/comparisons/`.
- Use the hosted item ID from `config/publish.yml` for overwrite operations.
